title: End of day: chase unpaid dues, then count the cash and close the day
aim: Do what the receptionist does at closing time. Part 1: use the dues list to leave a call note and send a payment reminder. Part 2: take a cash payment, try to close the day, clear the open appointments that block it, count the drawer with a difference, close, and then try to take another payment on the closed day. Check each message and how easy it is to know what to do next.
pre: Fresh local database. Dues list has 13 patients (₹13,500). Today has two stale rows from the seed: Manoj 10:00 AM 'Arrived' and Tara 10:30 AM 'In chair' (never finished). No payments yet today.
verdict: WORKS well, with a few dangerous or unclear spots
summary: Dues reminder and day close both work and give clear sentences: a payment-pending WhatsApp text with no amount, a required note when the counted cash differs, a closed-day result line with the difference, and a refusal of new payments on a closed day. The weak points: the blocking appointments are listed without patient names; Cancel on a Today row cancels at once with no question; and the 'late entry' that the closed-day message mentions cannot be found on screen.

problems.text: The Cancel button on a Today row cancels the appointment immediately: no confirm, no reason, no undo. The patient (an 'Arrived' patient who had been waiting) disappears from the list, the stat 'Arrived' drops to 0 and the page says '1 appointments today'. Cancel sits right next to 'In chair' on the same row.
problems.why: One mis-click removes a waiting patient from the queue. Cancelling is also not a no-show: the Call list stays empty, so the clinic does not know to call them back.
problems.fix: Ask 'Cancel Manoj's 10:00 AM appointment? Reason: [Patient cancelled / No-show / Other]' and put Cancel in a menu, away from In chair. Fix 'appointments' grammar.

problems.text: The Close day panel says '2 open appointments must be finished, marked no-show, or cancelled before close.' and lists '• Consultation · arrived' and '• Follow-up · in chair' without patient names. 'No-show' is not an action on the Today rows (only In chair, Cancel, Completed).
problems.why: The receptionist has to guess which appointments block the close, and the message offers an action (no-show) she cannot find.
problems.fix: List the names with a link to each row and add a No-show action.

problems.text: After closing, a new payment is refused: 'This day is closed. Use a late entry or ask the doctor to reopen it.' No 'late entry' option exists on the payment form and the form gives no 'ask the doctor' button.
problems.why: The sentence is clear but names a way out that the user cannot see.
problems.fix: Show a 'Record as late entry' choice with a reason, or a line 'Ask the doctor to reopen the day (Settings > ...)'.

problems.text: 'Add call note' opens a single bare text field inside the dues row; the note's date and result are not shown anywhere afterwards in this list.
problems.why: The receptionist cannot see that someone already called, so two people may call the same patient.
problems.fix: Show 'Called today: will pay Friday' under the name.

problems.text: The WhatsApp reminder opens WhatsApp at once for the first row clicked, with the text 'Dear Vikram, this is Align Dentistry. A payment is pending. Please call 0000000000 to arrange.' It is not listed in Messages.
problems.why: Text is correct and keeps to the privacy rule (no amount), but there is no record in Messages that it was sent. The clinic phone is still the sample 0000000000.
problems.fix: Log it in Messages as 'Opened'. Block when the clinic phone is not set.

good: The dues message follows the privacy rule: first name, clinic name, 'a payment is pending', phone. No rupee amount, no treatment.
A toast says 'WhatsApp opened with payment-pending text.'
Day close: 'Write a note explaining the cash difference.' is clear; after closing the line reads 'Closed. Counted ₹450 · Difference -₹50 · Gave change from own pocket' and 'Print day close' appears.
A payment on a closed day is refused with a sentence, and the dues balance stays unchanged.
notTested: Print of the day close, the monthly CSV export (button seen, not run), reopening a closed day (doctor), UPI totals on the close panel.
A no-show appointment from a past date and how it appears in the call list.
